---
title: "Minimal Example"
---

The smallest setup that produces hover previews: install the extension,
point `_quarto.yml` at the filter, done. This page is the result. Hover the
links under [Result](#result).

## Setup

```bash
quarto add ravila4/quarto-link-previews
```

```{.yaml filename="_quarto.yml"}
project:
  type: website

filters:
  - ravila4/link-previews
```

Previews inherit your site theme, light and dark.

## Result

Hover [the coffee-ring page](demo/coffee.qmd) for a full page preview, or
[a section inside the long page](demo/long-page.qmd#pinned-contact-lines)
to open the preview already scrolled to that heading.

Links the extension leaves alone: external ones like
[Quarto](https://quarto.org/), and any anchor carrying the `no-preview`
class, like [this link to the same coffee-ring
page](demo/coffee.qmd){.no-preview}.

## Optional configuration

Every key below is optional and shown at its default.

```{.yaml filename="_quarto.yml"}
extensions:
  link-previews:
    enabled: true       # false anywhere disables previews for that scope
    content: "#title-block-header, #quarto-document-content"
    delay: [300, 0]     # tippy show/hide delay in ms
    max-width: 500      # popover width in px
    exclude: []         # CSS selectors whose links never preview
```

The same block works in a page's front matter, where it replaces the site
settings for that page. [The long page](demo/long-page.qmd) does exactly
that to widen its own previews to 640px.

See [the documentation](index.qmd) for the full reference, styling hooks,
and known limitations.
